lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A repetitive grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and twelve vertical columns across the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal features run along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high pixel intensity on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, with a higher concentration towards the trailing edge.
